title: About Us
text_1: Welcome to AyaVn, Vietnam's online casting and crowdfunding platform to help artists and creators get paid, from castings, shows or events to contributions from fans. We connect casting professionals - like Casting Agencies, Production companies and Directors - with artists and creators such as Actors, Singers, Models or YouTubers. AyaVn is a unique casting platform on the web  that also links artists and creators to their fans, who can support them through a monthly subscription or a one-time tip (payment) to get exclusive content as a reward just like Patreon. Or like Cameo, our celebrities can send personalized video messages to fans, be it as birthday wishes or as wedding surprises. We call this Aya! „Entertainment, like friendship, is a fundamental human need; it changes how we feel and gives us common ground.   We want to entertain the world.   If we succeed, there is more laughter, more empathy, and more joy.“  “This is a quote from Netflix and I totally agree”, says Actor and Singer-Songwriter Lâm Vissay, who founded AyaVn 2021 in Ho Chi Minh City/Vietnam amid the pandemic.
text_2: The reality is, artists and creators struggle more than you think. That’s why getting them paid is essential, because it contributes a lot to people's positive change and happiness. Helping 1 artist make a living, that artist inspires 100 people to be more happy, have more empathy and joy, then the world is fantastic. If we give struggling creators a way to earn a fair living, it will result in 10,000 times better content in the future, which everyone benefits from. AyaVn is available in English and Vietnamese and, as you'll see, is much more than just a database.
text_3: This platform offers members the ideal setting for the special creative process that's behind each great casting, whether of a film, commercial photo shooting, music shows or business events. Artists and creators can use AyaVn’s multitude of tools to present themselves in an individual and personal way and to showcase their work to professionals in the industry or their fans.
